verdict.rationale: A direct probe shows n8n publishes a live llms.txt at docs.n8n.io (HTTP 200). It contains a structured index that links to Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. welcome.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at it. missing for 10: evidence of a fuller agent-oriented doc set (e.g. llms-full.txt or agent-specific guides), independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
